interface.title: One-Stop Analysis v1.5 (by ILYH)
interface.field: Cell biology / plate-based screening (siRNA knockdown, dose-response plate-reader assays)
interface.stage_of_work: Data processing, QC and statistical analysis after plate-reader acquisition, through to export for figure-making in GraphPad Prism
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser-only, single-page tool that merges a well/plate metadata file with one or more plate-reader result files, shows a plate heatmap and grouped bar charts, computes screening statistics (Z-score, SSMD, Z', D-ratio, Welch p), 4PL EC50 and 2-way ANOVA, and exports merged CSVs and GraphPad Prism XY, Column or Grouped tables.

data.note: Used 'Load Template Data' on Step 1. It loads template_design.csv (240 rows; Well, siRNA, Ins dose, Condition, Omit) and two result files, template_result_P1.csv and template_result_P2.csv (240 rows each; Well, Ratio). They sit on a 384-well layout (rows C–N, columns 3–22) with siNTC and siGene1–5, doses 0/0.1/1/10/100, and Normal/Disease conditions. No files were uploaded, and the template has no Plate column.

tree.specific: Merge siRNA plate design with Ratio readouts from two plates, QC the plate, compute assay/disease-window stats and EC50/ANOVA, and export Prism tables

screens_never_reached: Per-plate statistics (Plate column in Merge Key, Visualization and Statistics): the template has no plate column, so plate + well merging and per-plate splitting were never exercised
File upload / drag-and-drop dropzones: there were no test files to give them
Result Preview file switcher (template_result_P2.csv) on Step 1: not opened
Dose-Response 'All pairs' comparison mode and the XY 'exclude' option for dose 0: not selected
Column/Grouped Welch's t-test 'All pairs' / 'All col pairs' comparison modes and the Bracket star style: not selected
Welch's t-test on the Grouped table (test toggle, control column, family-wide correction): the Grouped table was built without its test
Most of the user guide (Step 2 and Step 4 sections, the outlier-removal and metric glossary): only Overview and Assay Window were viewed
not_done: Clicking a heatmap well only highlights it (screens/015.webp, screens/016.webp). It shows no tooltip and does not mask the well, so well exclusion only works from Step 2's Omit settings, not from the plate map.
Grouped Prism export chart is wider than its card and the 100-dose group is cut off at the right edge (screens/050.webp). I did not check whether it scrolls.
XY preview axis: the '0' tick label sits where dose 0 is plotted at 0.1 (screens/042.webp). There is no separate 0.1 tick, which could confuse readers.

In the XY export, Control group defaulted to siGene1, not siNTC (screens/044.webp). I had to change it by hand before the stars meant 'vs siNTC'. The replay also found the XY and Column control lists empty or stale until Transform was pressed once.

2-way ANOVA reports the siRNA/Condition main effect as SS 0.0019, p = 0.95 (screens/033.webp), even though the group plateaus clearly differ. Post-hoc tests at dose 100 are all highly significant (screens/037.webp). I did not verify which is correct.

Removing a group chip in the XY export applied to both Disease and Normal sub-tables (screens/046.webp). The removal did not carry over to the Column table type, which showed siGene5 again (screens/048.webp).
Exported .prism file (13 KB) is binary, so I could not inspect it. The PNG figure exports were not opened either.

Merged CSV export includes masked wells (C04, E19) even with 'Hide masked wells' ticked earlier. It contains the Omit column, but C04 shows Omit = 0 even though it was omitted through the Omit wells box.

Assay Window Export Stats CSV appears to ignore the table filter: on replay, filtering siRNA to 'siG' narrowed the on-screen table, but the downloaded 20261031_Assay_Win.csv began with siNTC rows (check/screens/014.webp).
